## Problem

What was wrong or missing before this change?

## Change

What changed, and why is this the smallest correct shape?

## Verification

List the commands and any manual checks you ran.

## Consequences

Call out changes to skill behaviour, lifecycle rungs, generated trees, plugin
versions, compatibility, security, configuration or documentation. Write "None"
for aspects you checked that do not change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I worked on a branch, not directly on `main`.
- [ ] I changed skill content only in `.claude/skills/` and regenerated all derived trees.
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] Documentation that would otherwise become false is updated.
- [ ] The diff contains no secret, `.env.local` value or private product artefact.
- [ ] Broad or behaviour-changing work has a linked issue.
